# LaunchPad

> LaunchPad is an AI-powered landing page builder that lets users create, customize, and publish high-converting landing pages with a visual editor, 43+ section types, drag-and-drop elements, and one-click deployment.

## Key Features

- Visual drag-and-drop editor with real-time preview
- 43+ section types with multiple design variants per section
- 11 element types: text, image, button, icon, badge, divider, countdown, social, video, form, HTML
- AI-powered page generation and copy editing
- Responsive breakpoint editing (desktop, tablet, mobile)
- Per-section typography, color, animation, and spacing controls
- Custom domain support with SSL
- SEO controls with meta tags, Open Graph, and JSON-LD structured data
- Export to static HTML, Next.js project, PDF, or copy sheet
- 12 professionally designed templates

## Templates

- [SaaS Product](https://launchpad.build): Free trial focused landing page
- [Course Funnel](https://launchpad.build): Online course sales funnel
- [Agency Funnel](https://launchpad.build): Agency and service business landing page
- [E-Commerce Funnel](https://launchpad.build): Product sales landing page
- [Webinar Registration](https://launchpad.build): Event and webinar signup page
- [Lead Magnet](https://launchpad.build): Ebook and lead generation page

## Section Types

Landing pages built with LaunchPad can include: Hero, Features, Testimonials, Pricing, FAQ, CTA, Stats, Process, Comparison, Video, Gallery, Founders, Logo Cloud, Credibility, Offer, Audience, Header, Footer, and 10 premium Whop University sections.

## Technology

Built with Next.js 15, React, Tailwind CSS, Zustand state management, Supabase for data, and deployed on Netlify.
